name: Com lang
summary: Báo Kon Tum quotes a visitor who names cơm làng among the foods at the weekend market, with smoked meat and traditional cakes. A recipe was not printed. It is not the cơm lam Vietnam Tourism describes. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den weekend market, in a visitor quote on Báo Kon Tum.
howToEat: The visitor names cơm làng and does not describe the plate.
Cơm lam, the bamboo-tube rice, is a different name on Vietnam Tourism.
A price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Cơm làng is a food a visitor names at the Mang Den weekend market on Báo Kon Tum. It is not cơm lam. A recipe and a price are Check on arrival.
